description: This PHP class defines a database migration script for version 5.2.0 of OrangeHRM, handling schema updates, data permissions, language strings, and configuration cleanup.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for updating schema, permissions, language strings, and configurations for OrangeHRM version 5.2.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs database schema updates, permission insertions, language string updates, and configuration cleanup.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for language string operations.

methods.name: updatePimLeftMenuConfigurators
methods.description: Updates the menu configurator for PIM module screens.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organization subunit name based on organization info.

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the homepage URL for a given user role.

methods.name: insertLDAPMenuItem
methods.description: Inserts LDAP configuration menu item into the admin menu.

methods.name: cleanLDAPAddonData
methods.description: Removes LDAP addon related data, screens, and modules.

methods.name: insertLangStringNotes
methods.description: Inserts notes into language strings from a YAML file.

methods.name: cleanI18nGroups
methods.description: Cleans up internationalization groups and reassigns language strings.
